data.body: A theme is a named palette and font set. Applying a theme to the site is an atomic, reversible operation and the only sanctioned way to change brand tokens.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • name (required)
  • description
  • whenToUse
  • scope
  • tokens (required)

Patch operations

  • set_theme_fields
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

thm_platform_docs keeps the verified Platform palette and adds explicit layout, shape, and type axes. A dry-run proved completeness before atomic application to the site.

Lifecycle note

The site copies theme tokens rather than live-binding to the recipe; publishing both records preserves the audit trail.
